title: Cosmic Lotus Portal
description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a glowing turquoise and purple swirling vortex at the center, resembling a portal or nebula. A thick black stylized line with curved, organic loops encircles the vortex like a frame or abstract figure, set against a swirling purple and blue starry background with small golden floral motifs and dark circular dots.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene with a glowing turquoise and magenta swirling vortex portal at the center containing a bright blue core and cloudy textures. A thick black organic line with elegant loops and curves wraps around the sphere like an abstract frame. Deep purple and blue swirling nebula background filled with stars and small glowing golden floral shapes, mystical and ethereal atmosphere, painted in vibrant digital art style
